players.product: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) anti-PD-1 therapy; intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), jointly developed with Moderna

quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: U.S. FDA Approves WELIREG (belzutifan) Plus LENVIMA (09-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA approved WELIREG (belzutifan) plus Eisai's LENVIMA (lenvatinib) for adults with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma after a PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor, which Merck and Eisai call the first approved HIF-2 alpha inhibitor plus VEGFR-TKI combination for these patients. In the Phase 3 LITESPARK-011 trial (747 patients) the combination reduced the risk of progression or death by 26% versus cabozantinib (HR=0.74, p=0.001; median PFS 14.6 vs 10.6 months) and improved ORR (53% vs 40%), while overall survival, the other primary endpoint, did not reach statistical significance at the final analysis.
quarterly_data.figure: PFS HR 0.74; median PFS 14.6 vs 10.6 months; ORR 53% vs 40%
